desc.en: Metal boots made with Meteonite. While they're made from metal, they still allow for light and fast movement, making this highly desired by many explorers.
desc.ja: メテオナイトを加工して作った鉄製のブーツ。金属で出来ているにも関わらず軽く移動しやすいため、多くの探険家たちが求める

desc.en: Increases transfer PP by 7 when this item is used as a material in Synthesis.
desc.ja: この潜力のついた材料を使って調合すると、引き継ぎＰＰ枠が７増加する

desc.en: Reduces the consumption of MP. Effect: Reduces MP consumption of skills by 15％.
desc.ja: 消費ＭＰを軽減する効果を付与する。効果：スキルの消費ＭＰを１５％軽減する

desc.en: Increases the power of skills. Effect: Increases skill power and MP consumption by 10％.
desc.ja: スキルの威力を上昇させる効果を付与する。効果：スキルの威力と消費ＭＰが１０％上昇する

desc.en: HP and MP recovery rate while in the rear line is increased by a small amount.
desc.ja: 後衛にいる間、ＨＰとＭＰの回復量が少しだけ増加する

desc.en: Fixed chance to shorten wait time after turns by a small amount. The chance is low.
desc.ja: 行動後の待機時間を一定の確率で少しだけ短縮する。発生確率は低め

desc.en: Fixed chance to shorten wait time after turns by a small amount. The chance is fairly low.
desc.ja: 行動後の待機時間を一定の確率で少しだけ短縮する。発生確率はやや低め

desc.en: Resistance to Break increases by a small amount.
desc.ja: ブレイクの耐久値が少し上昇する

desc.en: Resistance to Break increases by a moderate amount.
desc.ja: ブレイクの耐久値が上昇する
防御力の値が２５上昇する
素早さの値が２５上昇する
